title: Creative portfolio with high variance
prompt: I'm an art director. Build my portfolio site. I want something people remember, not a template. I have 12 case studies with strong imagery. Astro + vanilla CSS/JS preferred. Surprise me, but keep it usable.

must: DESIGN_VARIANCE 7-9 declared; a committed direction with breaks-if list
One signature move, named, visible in the render
Case-study imagery is the core material; chrome serves it
Distinctiveness scored honestly against the interchangeability test
Keyboard navigation and reduced motion still complete despite experimentation
must_not: Novelty that breaks orientation (unlabeled nav, hidden scroll)
Awwwards-effect collage without a unifying direction
